header.description: Hand-written starter jobs for the pilot StyleX subset. Ground truth is @stylexjs/babel-plugin 0.19.0 run live; every job verified against the oracle before commit.
header.notes: The cross-file jobs use corpus/hand/fixtures/default/src/tokens.stylex.ts, materialized on disk because the plugin resolves imported .stylex files via fs.existsSync (values are never read; const hashes are derived from the canonical file name).
